cases.name: frontmatter-is-not-a-block
cases.notes: Frontmatter is the revision's `frontmatter_blob`, not a `blocks` row (spec/store §3.1), so 24+ tokens of YAML never embed on their own; they reach the index only inside the whole-document input (reconstruct is the whole file).
